transcript.text: Good afternoon, sir! Welcome to Mr. Fletcher's Tailor Shop. How may I assist you today?

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: Ah, good afternoon to you. I am here with a matter of great importance. I recently placed an order for a custom-made suit with Mr. Fletcher's Tailor Shop, but upon receiving it, I have discovered several flaws in the craftsmanship. The stitching appears to be quite uneven, and there is a noticeable difference in the quality of the fabric used compared to what I had agreed upon. I am here to rectify this situation and ensure that the suit meets my expectations.

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text: Ah, I see. I'm afraid Mr. Fletcher is away on business and won't be back for several weeks. He's gone to Philadelphia to source new fabrics. Is there something I can help you with in the meantime?

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: While I understand Mr. Fletcher's current circumstances, I cannot耐心等待 his return. We must find a way to have this suit repaired promptly.

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text: I'm truly sorry for the inconvenience, sir, but I must inform you that all custom orders are final upon pickup. The receipt you signed states clearly that no alterations or refunds are given once the garment leaves the shop. Mr. Fletcher is very firm on this policy.

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: Well, then, I suppose we must find another solution. I cannot compromise on the quality of this suit. Is there any possibility of Mr. Fletcher returning early from his trip? Perhaps there is an urgent reason why he needs to stay in Philadelphia longer?

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text: I'm afraid not, sir. He's arranged meetings with suppliers that cannot be rescheduled. He won't be back for at least three weeks. I wish there was more I could do, but the policy is quite clear.

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: I understand your position, but I am deeply disappointed. I had faith in Mr. Fletcher's abilities and chose his shop because of its reputation for excellence. It is a shame that I am now left with a suit that does not meet my expectations. However, I must find a way to proceed despite this setback. Thank you for your understanding, and I will contact Mr. Fletcher upon my return to Springfield.

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text: Of course, sir. I'll let Mr. Fletcher know you stopped by when he returns. I'm sorry we couldn't resolve this to your satisfaction today. Safe travels back to Springfield.

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: Thank you for your understanding. I appreciate it. Good day to you.

transcript.speaker: antagonist
